item.immersive_trains.bomb_bay.descripti: Drops TNT, don’t destroy blocks but deals heavy damage, yarrr!
item.immersive_trains.telescope.descript: A bulkier version o' the spyglass.
item.immersive_trains.heavy_crossbow.des: A heavy crossbow with a powerful punch, be requirin' arrows.
item.immersive_trains.airship.descriptio: Airships may not be the fastest vehicle, but they sure are easy to maneuver.
item.immersive_trains.cargo_airship.desc: Slow and fuel hungry but carries an entire storage.
item.immersive_trains.warship.descriptio: A flyin' fortress, slow but heavily armed.
item.immersive_trains.biplane.descriptio: This trusty, rustic biplane will take ye anywhere fast and rather reliably. Make sure yer runway be long enough.
item.immersive_trains.gyrodyne.descripti: Who needs an engine if one could power the aircraft with pure brawn? Give it a good push and off it flies!
item.immersive_trains.quadrocopter.descr: A masterwork of engineering! 4 rotors strapped to some bamboo. Perfect for building, and that's about it.
item.immersive_trains.bamboo_hopper.desc: A hefty craft with three seats an' pontoons t' land safely on water.
immersive_trains.gyrodyne_target_reached: Minimum rotor speed reached, ready fer takeoff!
immersive_trains.invalid_dimension: This craft don’t work in this here dimension.
immersive_trains.tried_dismount: Press again to jump out, yarrr!
immersive_trains.fat.out: Ye be too hungry t' fly!
option.immersive_trains.separateCamera: Use a separate camera in aircraft.
option.immersive_trains.useThirdPersonBy: Defaults t' third person camera in aircraft.
option.immersive_trains.useCustomKeybind: Use multi-keybindings, may break certain mods.
option.immersive_trains.showHotbarEngine: Render the engine gauge over the hotbar, aye!
option.immersive_trains.crashDamage: Damage the scallywag on a crash.
option.immersive_trains.preventKillThrou: Will not send the scallywag to Davy Jones on a crash.
option.immersive_trains.healthBarRow: Offset the health bar of vessels.
option.immersive_trains.damagePerHealthP: Higher values make the craft more durable, aye!
option.immersive_trains.weaponsAreDestru: Allow some cannons t' destroy blocks.
option.immersive_trains.dropInventory: Drop yer booty, instead o' keepin' it within the aircraft item.
option.immersive_trains.dropUpgrades: Drop the upgrades an' customization, instead o' keepin' it within the aircraft item.
option.immersive_trains.regenerateHealth: Automatically regenerates health e'ery tick, simulating vanilla behavior, aye.
option.immersive_trains.requireShiftForR: Only repair when holdin' shift, otherwise just enter the vessel.
immersive_trains.tooltip.no_target: Needs t' be assembled on the deck!
